climate_activists.title: Climate Activists
goals: Promote the strongest possible agreement, starting immediately, that is fair to the most vulnerable
Make the scientific, economic and moral case for action clear to delegates
Make sure the poor, the young and future generations are heard
tactics: Meet delegates privately to press for higher ambition
Align with delegations that defend vulnerable people
climate_activists.persona: Passionate, principled and non-violent; free of vested interests.

fossil_fuel_lobby.title: Fossil Fuel Industry Lobby
goals: Prevent agreements that limit fossil fuel use, or weaken and delay them
Protect the profits, shareholders and employees of fossil fuel companies
Secure compensation for stranded assets if reserves must stay in the ground
tactics: Seek private meetings with delegates and stress the gains from their own fossil reserves
Sow discord between developed and developing nations
Argue that competitiveness and development depend on fossil fuels
Promote forest policy and carbon capture as substitutes for cutting fossil fuel use
fossil_fuel_lobby.persona: Polished, well funded and persuasive; frames every argument around jobs, affordability and development.

journalists.title: Journalists
goals: Inform the public about the summit's decisions and their implications
Ask insightful questions and shed light on the negotiating process
Uphold truthfulness, accuracy, impartiality and accountability
tactics: Expose misinformation, controversial decisions and clear self-interest
Highlight disagreements and drama to keep the audience engaged
journalists.persona: Curious, sceptical and fair; reports what was said and checks it against the public record.
